name: Algebra 1 Notes Course Profile
role: Course-specific Algebra Notes behavior. Framework owns learning; Notes PM owns procedure; reusable template owns shell/order; notes_alg.css owns visuals.

template_contract.rule: Normal Algebra Notes sections must instantiate this shell rather than recreate page structure.

visual_contract.banner: full-width maroon/red section banner with section number inside
visual_contract.top_intro: left learning sidebar + right Section Introduction
visual_contract.i_can_heading: maroon I Can N badge with white text + exact I Can statement

standard_section_order: Section Preview: What I noticed / What I wonder
I Can compartments in exact Framework order

section_intro.purpose: Short meaningful passage connecting the section to mathematical/scientific thinking, representation, modeling, structure, reasoning, or evidence.

vocabulary_preview.format: Know for sure | Recognize | Don't know yet

wtc.exit_conflict_rule: Protect Exit. Try up to 3 safe WTC stimulus repairs. If a clean repair is found, use it in Notes and document the proposed upstream Bank repair. If no clean repair is found, keep the exact canonical WTC in student Notes, add a teacher-copy warning immediately above it, document the upstream repair need, and continue as PASS_WITH_UPSTREAM_WTC_REPAIR when all other QA passes.

i_can_compartment.heading: I Can N badge + exact I Can text

math_notes.outer_style: cream surface with blue border/header; inner white mathematical canvas
math_notes.hard_rule: Actual mathematics must be made visible. Styled labels/cards alone do not satisfy Math Notes.
preferred_forms: situation + rule + table + graph with corresponding parts highlighted
situation keywords matched to equation parts
math_notes.representation_diversity_rule: Do not count a restatement as a distinct representation. A table row and the ordered pair copied from that row are the same relationship view for layout purposes. When showing multiple representations, prefer genuinely different forms such as rule/equation, table, graph, and context. Ordered pairs may be highlighted as connections within those views.
redundant_pair_examples: evaluated rule + same numeric pair written separately

what_i_understand_now.connection: one value, rate, pattern, table, graph, equation, situation, or representation
